name: Prince of Persia Classic
description: PS Vita homebrew port/wrapper for Prince of Persia Classic (Android), originally published by Ubisoft for Android,built on soloader-boilerplate.
long_description: Prince of Persia Classic is a 2012 release for Android and iOS devices that recreates the levels of the legendary 1989 classic game with modernized 3D graphics
requirements: - (Recommended) Make sure that you are either on 3.60 enso or 3.65 enso firmware version. Other versions may work too, but no support are provided for them! - Install or update kubridge and FdFix by copying kubridge.skprx and fd_fix.skprx to your taiHEN plugins folder - Make sure you have libshacccg.suprx in the ur0:/data/ folder on your console. If you don't, use ShaRKBR33D to get it quickly and easily.
